name: Authenticator App
tagline: A two-factor vault that hands out login codes only on your terms
description: Store your two-factor secrets in one place and pull the current six-digit code whenever a sign-in asks. A different assistant can receive a code only for services on your allow list, and the secret itself stays masked through every exchange.
author: refreshinga
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
